seo.title: 4-Day Desert Tour from Marrakech to Merzouga | Erg Chebbi & Dades (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €360 pp. Relaxed 4-day Marrakech desert tour to Merzouga (private VIP or shared). Includes Erg Chebbi dunes, camel ride, luxury camp & High Atlas mountains.
seo.lead: This four-day route gives you the full Marrakech-to-Merzouga desert experience at a much calmer pace than the standard three-day trip. Spreading the 1,100 km round trip across four days keeps daily driving legs between 4 and 6 hours, leaving more time to walk through Berber villages, visit kasbahs, and relax at your riads.
seo.primaryKeyword: 4 day desert tour from Marrakech to Merzouga

price.label: From EUR 360 per person
price.note: Includes private A/C 4x4 or minivan transport, licensed driver-guide, 2 nights in boutique riads/hotels (Dades Valley and Ouarzazate), 1 night in an Erg Chebbi desert camp, camel rides, dinners, and daily breakfasts from Day 2.

seo.imageAlt: Camel caravan trekking across golden Erg Chebbi dunes at sunrise during a 4-day Marrakech to Merzouga desert tour
highlights: Cross the High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi n'Tichka pass (2,260m)
Guided walk through the UNESCO-listed Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou
Walk along the canyon floor of the 300-meter-high Todra Gorges
Sunset and sunrise camel rides across the Erg Chebbi dunes in Merzouga
Overnight in a Sahara camp with dinner, campfire music, and stargazing
Unhurried 4-day pacing with an overnight stop in Ouarzazate on the return leg

faqs.question: Why choose the 4-day tour instead of the 3-day option?
faqs.answer: The 3-day itinerary requires a 9-to-10-hour drive on the final day from Merzouga back to Marrakech. Adding a fourth day breaks up that return leg with an overnight stay in Ouarzazate, keeping daily drives comfortable and giving you time to enjoy the Draa Valley.

faqs.question: What accommodations are included?
faqs.answer: You spend Night 1 in a riad or hotel in the Dades Valley, Night 2 in an Erg Chebbi desert camp, and Night 3 in a boutique riad or hotel in Ouarzazate. Luxury desert tents with private en-suite bathrooms are available on request.

faqs.question: Can this 4-day trip end in Fes instead of Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes. On Day 3, instead of driving west toward Ouarzazate, your driver can head north through the Ziz Valley, Midelt, and the Azrou cedar forest to drop you in Fes by early evening.

faqs.question: Which meals are included?
faqs.answer: All breakfasts (from Day 2) and all three evening dinners at your riads and desert camp are included. Lunches and drinks are at your own expense at scenic stops along the route.
